newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso still weak at close on "samba effect".
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso still weak at close on "samba effect".

text.p: Mexican peso contracts retained their sharp midday weakness at the close on Friday on speculative dollar buying triggered by plunging stock markets in Brazil.
"It is giving us a big headache...even if we don't have the same problems or economic strategy as Brazil," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 4.6 and 5.1 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.8990/7.9040 and 7.8950/7.9000 per dollar.
The Bovespa index of most active stocks in Sao Paulo was meanwhile down 3.54 percent at 11,314 points.
